headline: Quadrant Future Tek Limited IPO: Monitoring Agency Report (Q1 FY2026–27)
sum: Quadrant Future Tek Limited filed its Monitoring Agency Report with NSE for Q1 FY2026–27, confirming fund deployment tracking for its IPO proceeds as mandated by SEBI regulations.
implication: The filing evidences continued regulatory compliance post-IPO closure; practitioners should note that monitoring agency reports are mandatory quarterly disclosures under SEBI's IPO monitoring regime and serve as audit checkpoints for fund deployment against offer document commitments.
detail: Quadrant Future Tek Limited, a technology company, completed an IPO and is now required under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 to file quarterly Monitoring Agency Reports tracking the utilisation of IPO proceeds. The August 12, 2026 filing covers the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY2026–27), representing the company's post-listing compliance cycle. This is standard post-IPO governance: a SEBI-appointed independent Monitoring Agency audits the company's fund deployment against commitments made in the IPO prospectus and reports quarterly to the stock exchange and regulator.
